candidate_reports.remark: Highway 95 southbound near the Nevada and California border closed due to flooding.
Mountain View Road from East Crystal Drive to East Desert Greens Drive closed due to flash flooding.
Several streets are flooded out across the city of Joshua Tree south of Highway 62.
Strong gradient winds resulted in a wind gust of 63 mph at Lake Havasu City Airport. KHII.
Swift water rescue at Wigwam Parkway and Pittman Wash due to flash flooding.
Debris and flowing water over the roadway. Hard closure of Amboy Road at Amboy and Godwin and Amboy and Chadwhich.
Vehicle stuck in flash flood waters at Amboy Road and Bauman Drive.
Gusts in excess of 58 mph started at 0430 and continued through 0540. Peak gust was 65 mph at 0440 and 0520 measured at Holy Moses Wash. AZT23.
Mid Hills RAWS measured a gust of 61 mph due to gradient winds. MDHC1.
Truxton Canyon RAWS measured a gust of 73 mph from nearby thunderstorms. TCRA3.
Swift water rescue at South Valley View Boulevard and Tara Avenue due to flash flooding.
Swift water rescue at South Valley View Boulevard and West Sahara Avenue due to flash flooding.
Swift water rescue at West Cheyenne Avenue and North Rampart Boulevard due to flash flooding.
Winds in excess of 58 mph began at 0600 and continued until 0655 at the US 93 Hoover Dam Bridge. Peak wind gust of 74 mph at 0630. HDMNV.
Downed power line in Barstow Heights due to nearby thunderstorms.
Cars trapped in water. Several swift water rescues due to flash flooding.
Swift water rescue at West Washington Avenue and North Decatur Boulevard due to flash flooding.
Swift water rescue at Harmon and Arville due to flash flooding.
Swift water rescue at West Sahara Avenue and South Rancho Drive due to flash flooding.
Swift water rescue at North Decatur Boulevard and West Washburn Road due to flash flooding.
Water and debris over State Route 159 near Moenkopi Lane due to flash flooding. Time estimated by radar.
Swift water rescue of 2 people at Gilespie Street and East Richmar Avenue due to flash flooding.
Swift water rescue at West Sahara Avenue and South Rancho Drive due to flash flooding.
Roadway flooded and impassable on Molino Circle at Santa Maria Avenue.
Cars stuck in water ponding along Interstate 215 at Charleston.
Swift water rescue on North Rancho Drive and West Alexander Road due to flash flooding.
Flash flooding over Smoketree Avenue South at Rotary Park at Pima Wash.
Debris over the roadway in Death Valley along State Route 190 at mile marker 64. Debris includes branches and boulders.
Six swift water rescues occurred across the Kingman area between 0700 and 1000.
Video shows substantial debris over Joe Davis Drive. Road is impassable and has been closed.
Video shows 5 to 6 inches of water flowing over London Bridge Road in Lake Havasu City.
Wind gust of 58 mph measured at Tweeds Point RAWS. QTWA3.
Winds in excess of 58 mph began at 0841 and continued until 0941 at Kane Springs RAWS. Peak gust was 75 mph at 0841. KNSN2.

Spotter reported flash flooding over numerous roads in southern Lake Havasu City including debris such as mailboxes and other landscaping over the roadway. Primary road is McCulloch Boulevard South at the Chemehuevi Wash.
West Shinarump Drive is closed from South Aztec Road to West Oatman Road due to flash flooding.
China Ranch Road is washed and unsafe to drive on.
Wind gust of 62 mph measured at Black Rock sensor QBRA3.
Webcam shows water flowing over Stockton Hill Road at Vock Wash.
Photo shows exposed pipes due to erosion from flash flooding in Downtown Kingman.
Photos show a car submerged in water under an underpass.

Flash flooding on N Castle Rock Road from E Northern Avenue to E Swan Drive resulted in a road closure due to water and debris. Several additional roads were closed in the neighborhood just to the east that intersected the same wash.
Flash flooding on N Estrella Road from W Chino Drive to W Zuni Drive resulted in a road closure due to water and debris.
Flash flooding on W Shinarump Drive from S Aztec Road to S Colorado Road resulted in a road closure due to water and debris.
Flash flooding on S Oatman Highway from S Sacramento Road to E Navajo Drive resulted in a road closure due to water and debris.
Car stuck in ponded water on Gilespie at Robindale.
State Route 62 closed from Godwin Road to the SR62 SR177 interchange.
State Route 62 closed from US 95 to the Arizona State Line.
Flash flooding on White Hills Road at Detrital Wash. Flood wave along Detrital Wash peaked at 4.08 feet.
Video shows water flowing in the Truxton Wash over Hackberry Road.
Flash flooding on S Oatman Highway from E Tule Drive to East Interstate 40 Frontage Road resulted in a road closure due to water and debris.
Webcam shows Route 66 washed out. Image shows water up to roof of jeep as well as a pickup truck stuck in water over tires.
Mojave National Preserve reports flooded and damaged roads with debris over roadways. Photo shows undercut roadway.
Flash flooding on White Hills Road at Detrital Wash resulted in a road closure. Flood wave along Detrital Wash peaked at 4.28 feet.
Strong gradient winds resulted in a wind gust of 70 mph near Chloride AZ.
Several power poles downed near Mineral Park due to strong gradient winds.
CHP reporting active flooding on CA190 and Panamint Valley Road. Closure of Trona Wild Rose Road required along with flood signage.
Report of water flowing over CA 190 at mile marker 97/Salt Creek.
Barstow-Daggett ASOS gusted to 58 mph at 104 PM PDT due to a nearby thunderstorm.
Barstow-Daggett ASOS gusted to 58 mph at 104 PM PDT due to a nearby thunderstorm.

The RAWS station at Five Mile (FMRC1) began reporting gusts in excess of 58 mph at 1:26 am PDT. Gusts in excess of 58 mph continued through 8:26 am PDT. The peak gust during this time was 69 mph and occurred at 5:26 am PDT.
